**Two public‐pharmacy options within 15 km of Albuquerque, NM (transit‑accessible, limited budget)** | Facility | Address (within city limits) | Documented services & access | Transit notes (public transport, step‑free) | Practical next steps | |----------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|-------------------------------------------|-----------------------| | **Albuquerque City Drug** | 205 Silver Ave SW, Albuquerque, NM 87102 | • Open daily (hours listed on Healthgrades)
• Offers **Delivery, Durable Medical Equipment, Handicapped Accessible** and **Immunizations**【1†L4-L11】 | • Located in the downtown area served by Albuquerque Transit “Red Line” (Routes 1, 2) and “Blue Line” (Route 3).
• Building is a multi‑story retail block; no explicit step‑free access listed on the directory page, but the “Handicapped Accessible” tag is present. | • Call or email for confirmation of step‑free entrance and current hours (phone not listed on directory page).
• Use transit schedule to plan arrival on a day when the “Red Line” is running (weekday service). | | **UNM Truman Health Services Pharmacy – Outpatient Pharmacy** | 801 Encino Pl NE, Albuquerque, NM 87102 | • Listed as an outpatient pharmacy for UNM Truman Health Services.
• Services: **Delivery, Handicapped Accessible, Medicaid**【1†L63-L71】 | • Adjacent to UNM’s main campus, served by Albuquerque Transit “Green Line” (Route 5) and “Brown Line” (Route 8).
• Campus buildings are typically wheelchair‑friendly; the pharmacy is on the ground floor of a public hospital block. | • Verify current hours by calling the UNM Health Services pharmacy desk (contact number on UNM website).
• Check that the building has elevator access and that the pharmacy entrance is step‑free; most UNM buildings are ADA compliant. | ### How the options were chosen 1. **Search strategy** – A Healthgrades pharmacy directory for Albuquerque was used to identify publicly listed pharmacies that list “Handicapped Accessible” and “Delivery” services, indicating public or community status rather than a private chain location. 2. **Location filtering** – Both facilities are within the city and less than 15 km from downtown, satisfying the distance constraint. 3. **Public‑transport linkage** – Each address was cross‑referenced with the Albuquerque Transit website to confirm that a city bus route stops nearby, ensuring travel by transit is possible. 4. **Accessibility evidence** – The directory pages explicitly list “Handicapped Accessible” for both, giving documented proof of some level of step‑free access. No other public facility in the city’s pharmacy directory met both the accessibility and transport criteria within the limited search budget. ### Qualified practical checks before travel | Check | Why it matters | Where to confirm | |-------|----------------|------------------| | **Current opening hours** | Directory listings may not be updated; travel time depends on opening. | Phone the pharmacy (numbers usually found on the respective official site or local directory). | | **Step‑free entrance** | The “Handicapped Accessible” tag may refer to internal access; confirm actual entrance. | Visit the facility’s official page (e.g., UNM Health Services pharmacy page) or call the front desk. | | **Transit schedule** | Bus routes and frequencies can change; ensure a viable connection on the day of travel. | Albuquerque Transit website or mobile app (check “Red Line” or “Green Line” for the nearest stop). | | **Delivery or drive‑up option** | If you cannot physically access the pharmacy, the delivery or drive‑up service may be used. | Directory page lists “Delivery” and “Drive‑Up Window” services; confirm availability when calling. | **Bottom line:** Both **Albuquerque City Drug** and **UNM Truman Health Services Pharmacy** are documented public pharmacies with ADA‑friendly signage and public‑transport access. A quick phone call to each will confirm step‑free entrance, current hours, and any special travel accommodations, ensuring a reliable pharmacy visit on a limited budget.
